title: Override
description: Immutable trust artifact recording an authorized human override for a Business Transaction. No API route in this repository currently creates an Override; this schema exists only because ExecutionTrustRecord.overrides is part of the append-only Trust Record shape; every captured example has an empty overrides array.

businessTransactionId.description: Business Transaction to which this Override belongs.

approvedBy.description: Authorized user or system that approved the Override.

approvedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the Override was approved.
